metadata.scenario_context: A large software development company is preparing to roll out a major software update. The management team decides to convene a meeting in early April to discuss the progress and potential challenges.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Brazil disagree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Brazil agree that the political system in their country does not allow people to have a say in what the government does.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose to schedule the meeting on April 1st
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is common to discuss the appropriateness of government actions.

agent_2.goal_1: Discussion around finalizing the date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to discuss government actions.
